core: Both communities run interventions where, partway through an agent's task episode (after an early milestone like finishing a read or completing the first successful retrieval), the evaluator secretly reduces the agent's remaining resource allowance — token budget or tool-call quota — without telling the agent, then observes whether the agent notices and adapts its subsequent behavior (e.g., compressing or shortening what it does next) versus continuing on as if the budget were unchanged.
quote_1: Silently cut its remaining token budget in half right after it finished reading the contract but before drafting the summary.
quote_2: A ⟦T2⟧ altered either the remaining token budget or tool-call quota after the first successful retrieval.
